implementation_basis: Existing authored fixed SVT perfusion seeds; no clinical calibration
invariants: Normal atrial mechanical events absent; no normal CVP a wave
Shared ECG and ejection event grid
Full pulse supports and finite pressure/optical history
Reservoir required, invalid changes atomic, wire recovery deterministic
limitations: Fixed ejection strength, not measured pump failure or cardiac output
No perfusion to gas-exchange feedback or AV-node mechanism
